newsitem.title: USA: SBC reports Q1 pro forma results.
newsitem.headline: SBC reports Q1 pro forma results.

text.p: SBC Communications Inc said Friday that its first quarter earnings per share, on a pro forma basis to reflect the the April 1 merger with Pacific Telesis Group, increased to $0.94 from $0.86 before a prior year accounting change -- but the 1997 results included a one-time gain of about $0.10 per share.

SBC said pro forma reported income rose to $857 million from $798 million before the $90 million cumulative impact of a first quarter 1996 accounting change related to Pacific Bell directory operations.
In the first quarter of 1997 Pacific Telesis recorded a $90 million one-time settlement gain associated with lump sum pension payments.

Earnings before the cumulative effect of the accounting change and the one-time item were $767 million or $0.84 per share for the first quarter of 1997, versus $798 million or $0.86 per share for first quarter 1996, SBC said.
The company said revenues increased 7.5 percent, from $5.6 billion to $6.0 billion, in the first quarter on a pro forma basis.
The companies reported their first quarters last month on a stand alone basis.
